evidence: Directly modifies libbitcoinkernel callback dispatch in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, headers in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and tests in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a deadlock in libbitcoinkernel where log callbacks hang if they re-entrantly log or trigger object destruction. Dispatching callbacks outside the logger mutex resolves real-world hangs experienced when language runtimes like Python run garbage collection finalizers during logging.
